theater: 越北諒山與廣西鎮南關

battle.name: 中法戰爭
battle.theater: 越北諒山與廣西鎮南關
battle.brief: 一八八三年五月法軍攻陷河內，越南落入法國控制，清廷先遣雲南兵剿黑旗軍，後以兩廣、雲南兩路大軍入安南。一八八四年三月桂軍與黑旗軍在廣西鎮南關前同法軍血戰，法軍線膛砲射程遠勝清軍舊砲，關隘幾度易手；清軍靠夜襲與山道截擊才收復諒山，最終仍以撤出越南收場。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰的兩方是法國與清朝。法國一方以法國陸軍遠東方面軍為骨幹，部隊在安南分成沿海與山區兩種任務：沿海的遠東分艦隊由海軍上將庫爾貝率領，配著裝甲巡洋艦、巡洋艦與砲艦，掩護陸軍在海防、升龍、諒山一線登陸與推進；陸上主力是三個步槍團與混合營，每營以數百人計，兵員裡有法國本土殖民兵、非洲步槍兵、外國雇傭兵與安南本地協戎民兵，指揮系統由遠東軍總司令與海軍分隊長分掌，後方則由河內與西貢兩處軍需中心供應。安南方面仍名義上由阮朝皇帝阮寶山統治，實權落在輔政大臣阮有與權臣阮春手裡，法軍到處扶植地方武裝作為偵察與運輸的耳目。清廷一方由兩廣與雲南兩個省分組織前線：廣西方面設軍務大臣，由張之洞總攬，招募桂勇、湘勇與客軍，改編為鎮南關與諒山兩處的防守與反攻部隊；雲南方面由總督岑毓英率領滇軍自雲南出兵，與黑旗軍劉永福部同受節制。除正規官軍之外，還有大量挑夫、轎夫與夫役隨軍搬運。整場戰爭法軍的規模由最初數千人增至上萬人，而中方投入雲南、廣西兩省的兵員與夫役合計達數萬人，雙方都靠大量非戰鬥人員維持戰線。
countriesEn: The two sides were France and the Qing dynasty. On the French side the backbone was the French army in the Far East, whose forces were split between coastal and mountain tasks. The Far East naval squadron in the estuary was led by Admiral Courbet and was made up of armoured cruisers, cruisers and gunboats; it covered the landing and the advance of the army along the line of Haiphong, Thang Long and Lang Son. The main land force consisted of three rifle regiments and mixed battalions, each battalion counting several hundred men. The ranks included colonists from metropolitan France, African riflemen, foreign mercenaries and Annamite auxiliary militia, and the chain of command divided the theatre between a commander of the Far East army and a naval detachment leader, while two supply centres at Hanoi and Saigon fed the whole system. In Annam the Nguyễn dynasty still nominally reigned under Emperor Nguyễn Phúc Đồng Khánh, with real power in the hands of the regent Nguyễn Văn Tường and the minister Tôn Thất Thuyết; everywhere the French raised local armed groups to serve as eyes and as carriers for supplies. The Qing side organised the front from two provinces. Guangxi created a post of military affairs commissioner held by Zhang Zhidong, who recruited Guangxi braves, Hunan braves and mercenary contingents and reorganised them into units for the defence of Zhennan Pass and of Lang Son. Yunnan was to send its own army into northern Annam under Governor-General Cen Yuying, operating together with Liu Yongfu's Black Flag Army. Beyond the regular troops a great many porters, palanquin bearers and other auxiliaries marched with the armies to carry ammunition and grain. The scale of the war grew from a few thousand French soldiers at the start to more than ten thousand, while on the Chinese side the troops and auxiliaries drawn from Yunnan and Guangxi together reached several tens of thousands. Both sides depended on large numbers of non-combatants to hold their lines.
people: 決定戰局走向的是一批中法雙方的將領與文臣。法國方面，總理茹費理把遠東擴張視為國家政策，主持向安南增兵；駐清公使巴德諾在談判桌上屢次提出越界與撤軍的最後通牒。軍隊方面，遠東軍總司令尼格里率部攻取北寧、山西與諒山，一八八四年三月在鎮南關前受重傷；接任的波特把援軍送進諒山，包圍數月，卻在五月被迫放棄重地。中國方面，兩廣總督張樹聲在開戰初期主持應戰，雲南總督岑毓英率滇軍深入安南北部攻擊宜光，進展緩慢而後退，兵糧漸盡；廣西巡撫張之洞接管前線後，一面催款購械，一面經營後方，並在一八八四年三月重新起用被參劾去職的馮子材督軍鎮南關。馮子材是廣西客軍出身的老將，領桂軍與黑旗軍在關前隘與觀音山一線死守，二十四日那夜他襲破敵營，官軍陣亡者有記名總兵王德榜等數人；五月他配合黑旗軍迂迴反攻，迫法軍退出諒山。雲南的黑旗軍首領劉永福原是廣西欽州起義的農民領袖，一八七三年曾在紙橋擊退法軍，一八八三年受招撫後編為官軍，成為清廷倚重的游擊主力。外交上，總理大臣李鴻章力主和議，與法方往返磋商；駐法公使曾紀澤赴巴黎交涉未能阻止戰事。戰後清廷內部反覆：張之洞與李鴻章在對法態度上大不相同，主和者以撤兵換取法國承認雲南主權，主戰者則指責條件苛刻，朝野對這份條約的評價至今仍是清末外交史上一樁公案。
peopleEn: The course of the war was decided by a set of commanders and statesmen on both sides. On the French side, the prime minister Jules Ferry treated the expansion in the Far East as national policy and presided over the reinforcement of Annam; the minister to China, Patenôtre, repeatedly put forward final notices about the frontier and about withdrawal at the negotiating table. In the field, the commander of the Far East army, de Négrier, led the captures of Bac Ninh, Son Tay and Lang Son and was wounded before Zhennan Pass in March 1884; his successor Bouët brought reinforcements into Lang Son and maintained a siege for several months, yet was forced to abandon the place in May. On the Chinese side, the viceroy of Liangguang, Zhang Shusheng, directed the opening phase of the war, while the governor-general of Yunnan, Cen Yuying, drove his Yunnan troops deep into northern Annam against Huong Giang; the advance was slow and then reversed, and the food ran short. The governor of Guangxi, Zhang Zhidong, took over the front, pressing for funds and weapons, organising the rear areas, and in March 1884 returning to command the man who had been cashiered and cashiered again by impeachment, Feng Zicai. Feng was an old general from the Guangxi mercenary contingents; he held the line at Guanqianai and on Guanyin Hill with the Guangxi troops and the Black Flags, and on the twenty-fourth he struck the enemy camp by night, the Chinese losing among their dead the titled commander Wang Debang and several others. In May he coordinated a turning movement with the Black Flags and forced the French out of Lang Son. Liu Yongfu, the Black Flag leader out of Yunnan, had begun as a peasant insurgent from Qinzhou in Guangxi, had turned back the French at Paper Bridge in 1873, and was incorporated into the imperial forces after his submission in 1883, becoming the irregular main stay on which the Qing relied. In diplomacy, the grand secretary Li Hongzhang pressed for a negotiated settlement and exchanged drafts with the French; the minister in Paris, Tseng Chi-se, failed to prevent the war. After the war the Qing court went back and forth on the settlement: Zhang Zhidong and Li Hongzhang differed sharply in their approach, the advocates of peace offering a withdrawal in exchange for a French recognition of Chinese sovereignty over Yunnan, while the advocates of war denounced the terms as harsh. The reception given to that treaty by the public remains a standing case in the diplomatic history of the late Qing.
kits: 卡面上這門德造線膛砲，屬於一八五〇年前後興起的那一類線膛野砲：以金屬藥筒盛載發射藥，藥筒與炮膛之間留出密閉火藥室，燒灼時氣體沿溝槽旋轉加速，因此射程比同期的滑膛砲遠得多。嚴格說，卡面這一門砲的具體型號無法在戰場記錄中逐一對應，但它代表的德造線膛技術，正是這場戰爭裡清軍花大錢買回來的東西。就實際的裝備而言，線膛砲在兩邊的陣列裡都有位置。法軍的野戰砲主力是八〇年型八〇公厘前裝線膛砲，最大射程可達五千公尺上下，有效射程約二三千公尺，另配一二〇公分與一五五公分大口徑野戰砲與攻城砲，後者用於攻擊關隘與築壘據點。清軍在廣西的砲兵則以德國購來的後膛線膛砲為骨幹，一八八三年起分批向德國廠商訂購十二公分與八七公分口徑的克虜伯式砲，這批砲射程更遠、射後即可再裝，但數量有限，運到前線時已落後於軍隊推進速度；其餘仍靠舊式抬砲與銅砲湊數，射程只有一千數百公尺，遇上法軍線膛砲的射界便處處受制。除火炮之外，兩軍的步槍差距更大：法軍裝配一八七九年式與一八六〇年式的格拉塞步槍，有效射程三四百公尺；清軍則是新式洋槍、舊式火槍與冷兵器混編的隊伍，密集隊形在射程與火力上都難以抵擋。輔助兵器方面，法軍有過山砲與迫擊砲，能把炮彈從山後越過我方壘壘；清軍用竹木、拒馬與鹿角壘成街壘，靠人力肩扛把砲運上關隘。輸送全靠騾馬、牛車與挑夫，紅河三角洲到諒山的山地補給線長達一百五十公里以上，乾季水少、人力不足，使法軍炮彈與糧秣的補充速度遠落後於砲本身的射程優勢。
kitsEn: The German rifled field gun on the card belongs to the class of rifled field artillery that took shape around 1850. It fires from a metal cartridge case containing the propellant charge, with a sealed chamber between the case and the bore; as the charge burns, the gas spins along the grooves and gains speed, so the gun outranges the smooth-bore pieces of the same period. Strictly speaking, the exact model shown on the card cannot be matched one to one against the battle records, but the German rifled technology it stands for is precisely what the Qing bought back at great expense in this war. In terms of equipment actually in use, the rifled gun had a place in both armies. The backbone of the French field artillery was the eighty millimetre muzzle-loading rifled gun of the 1870 model, with a maximum range of around five thousand metres and an effective range of roughly two to three thousand, backed by 120 and 155 millimetre field pieces and siege guns, the latter used against passes and fortified positions. The Chinese artillery in Guangxi was built around breech-loading rifled guns bought from German firms; from 1883 the Qing ordered batches of Krupp-pattern pieces of 120 and 87 millimetres in calibre. Those guns outranged everything else and could be reloaded without withdrawing the crew, but their numbers were small and they reached the front after the infantry had already moved ahead. The rest was made up with old muzzle-loading village guns and old bronze pieces whose range was only a thousand metres or so, and which were helpless once they came within the arc of fire of the French rifled batteries. The gap in small arms was wider still. The French carried the 1879 and 1860 Gras rifles, effective to three or four hundred metres, while the Chinese units mixed modern foreign rifles, old matchlock muskets and cold weapons, and such formations in close order could neither outrange nor outfire the enemy. In supporting weapons the French had mountain howitzers and mortars capable of lobbing shells over the Chinese entrenchments, while the Chinese built streets of bamboo, chevaux-de-frise and abatis and had their guns carried up to the passes on human shoulders. Everything moved on mules, ox carts and porters: the mountain supply line from the Red River delta to Lang Son ran more than a hundred and fifty kilometres, and in the dry season, with short water and short labour, the French could not feed their shells and their magazines nearly as fast as the reach of their guns.
tactics: 法軍的攻勢有固定的次序：先以大炮群在對方壘壘前展開齊射，再以步兵縱隊沿山道與田埂分批前進，縱隊之間保持數百公尺距離，遇到清軍步槍射程即伏低或以連隊散開，最後由工兵與突擊隊攀上關隘。法軍最擅長的是以數量與射程壓住對手的火力，再用人數磨掉對手的抵抗；弱點是連續作戰之後士氣與體力耗散，遇雨季泥濘、遇旱季缺水，傷病比例遠高於陣亡。法軍還有一項吃虧的地方：一旦深入山區，糧道拉長，抬運的夫役在伏擊下損失慘重，炮彈存量常常不足一日之用。清軍與黑旗軍的做法相反，重視地形與奇襲。鎮南關前的關前隘是狹窄的山脊通道，清軍在兩側山頭築壘架砲，主力伏於壘後，等法軍縱隊進入狹隘才以步槍與冷兵器夾擊；黑旗軍熟悉越南山道，能在夜色中繞到法軍側後，切斷其退路並焚毀糧秣。諒山之戰中，桂軍與黑旗軍的反攻正是從攻擊法軍的糧道與營壘下手，逼得法軍放棄重地撤退，撤退途中在山道上被追擊與截殺，首尾不能相顧。雲南方面的滇軍則偏向正面強攻，屢次強攻宜光、興化等城不下，糧秣不繼而退回。中方整體的弱點在於指揮分散：桂勇、湘勇、滇軍與黑旗軍分屬不同將領，缺少統一炮兵指揮，各部出擊的時間與方向配合不上，使法軍得以逐次應付各個方向，而不必同時應付全部。
tacticsEn: The French assault followed a fixed order. First a battery group opened a bombardment against the Chinese entrenchments, then infantry columns advanced in successive batches along mountain paths and field ridges, the columns keeping a few hundred metres between them, flattening into the grass or breaking into company formation as soon as they came within the range of Chinese muskets, and finally engineers and assault teams climbed the passes. What the French did best was to overwhelm the enemy's fire with numbers and range and then grind down his resistance with bodies; their weakness was that morale and stamina drained after continuous operations, that rain turned the tracks to mud and drought cut the water, and that sickness and wounds took far more men than enemy fire. Another French handicap appeared once they pushed into the mountains: the supply route stretched, the porters carrying ammunition were cut up in ambushes, and the shell stocks often held less than a single day's firing. The Chinese and the Black Flags worked in the opposite way, and put terrain and surprise first. Guanqianai in front of Zhennan Pass was a narrow ridge road, and the Chinese built works and mounted guns on the heights on either side, kept the main strength behind the works, and waited until the French column was inside the defile before closing with muskets and cold weapons from both flanks. The Black Flags knew the Vietnamese hills intimately and could move by night round the French flank and rear, cut the line of retreat and burn the magazines. In the Lang Son fighting the turning movement by the Guangxi troops and the Black Flags began precisely at the French magazines and supply line, and it was the loss of those that forced the French to leave the place; on the march out the French were harassed and intercepted on the mountain path, so that the head of the column and its tail could not support each other. The Yunnan army, by contrast, leaned on frontal assault, failed repeatedly to take such towns as Huong Giang and Huong Hoa, and withdrew when its food ran out. The structural weakness of the Chinese side lay in the dispersal of command: the Guangxi braves, the Hunan braves, the Yunnan army and the Black Flag army belonged to different commanders, there was no unified artillery control, the timing and direction of the separate attacks did not fit together, and the French could therefore meet one direction at a time instead of all of them at once.
data: 時間跨度是這場戰爭最好記的一條：法軍於一八八三年五月十九日攻陷河內安南王城，清廷自此出兵，戰事延續到一八八五年六月九日北京簽訂中法天津條約，前後約兩年；若自一八八四年六月二十三日清廷正式宣戰算起，則約十二個月。兵力上，法軍在安南的陸軍由最初不足三千人增至一八八四年的一萬人上下，此外有法國海軍遠東分艦隊十餘艘，以及相當數量的雇傭兵與安南協戎民兵；中方投入雲南、廣西兩省的兵員合計數萬人，其中滇軍與桂勇、湘勇各佔萬餘，另有同等數量的夫役與挑夫，規模上遠大於法軍而戰鬥力不成比例。戰役數字以鎮南關與諒山最為密集：一八八四年三月二十三日至二十四日的關前隘之戰，法軍出動兩三千人，中方投入四五千人，兩日之間法軍傷亡數百人，其中軍官陣亡二十餘名，陣地屢易其手；三月起法軍圍困諒山，四月援軍抵達後再度合圍，圍城軍與增援軍合計四千上下，中方參戰兵力上萬，法軍撤退時的損失各書記載不一，常見數字是陣亡四百上下、傷者五百上下，而同期病患數以千計，說明遠東戰役真正吞掉法軍的是叢林與痢疾而不是子彈。福州海戰是另一個數字節點：一八八四年八月二十三日法艦在閩江口攻擊福建水師，中方十艘上下的艦船沉沒或失去戰鬥力，官兵陣亡以千人計，法軍亦有傷亡與一艘巡洋艦受創。臺灣方面，一八八四年十月到一八八五年三月法軍先後投入兩批遠征隊合計四五千人，劉銘傳部依托淡水與基隆城防，最後在三角湧一役擊退法軍。射程與消耗亦可比較：法軍八〇公厘線膛砲最大射程五千公尺上下，清軍舊式抬砲射程一千數百公尺，同樣一發炮彈的射程差達三倍以上，後方支援因此更難拉上火線。財政上，法國戰費以億計，常見統計在數億佛郎上下；清廷支出則分散在兩廣、雲南的軍需與轉運開支，數額達數千萬銀兩，其中因運力不足造成的浪費佔了相當部分。
dataEn: The span of the war is the easiest fact to remember. The French seized the citadel of Hanoi on the nineteenth of May 1883, the Qing court began sending armies, and the fighting ran on until the Sino-French Treaty of Tientsin was signed at Peking on the ninth of June 1885, a matter of about two years; counted from the formal declaration of war by the Qing court on the twenty-third of June 1884, about twelve months. On numbers, the French army in Annam grew from fewer than three thousand men to around ten thousand by 1884, with a dozen or more ships of the Far East naval squadron and a substantial number of mercenaries and Annamite auxiliary militia besides. The Chinese committed troops from the two provinces of Yunnan and Guangxi together in the tens of thousands, the Yunnan army and the Guangxi and Hunan braves each numbering more than ten thousand, with an equal number again of auxiliaries and porters, so that in scale the Chinese armies were far larger than the French while their fighting power was not in proportion. The figures of the fighting itself are densest around Zhennan Pass and Lang Son. In the battle of Guanqianai on the twenty-third and twenty-fourth of March 1884 the French committed two or three thousand men and the Chinese four or five thousand; within those two days the French suffered several hundred casualties including more than twenty officers killed, and the position changed hands repeatedly. From March the French besieged Lang Son, and after reinforcements arrived in April they encircled it again; the besieging force and the relief column together numbered around four thousand, while more than ten thousand Chinese took part. The accounts of the French losses on the retreat differ; the figures usually given are about four hundred dead and about five hundred wounded, while the sick numbered in the thousands over the same period, which shows that what really consumed the French army in the Far East was the jungle and dysentery rather than bullets. The fight at Foochow marks another set of figures: on the twenty-third of August 1884 the French squadron attacked the Fujian Fleet in the mouth of the Min River, some ten Chinese ships were sunk or disabled, the officers and men of the fleet were killed by the thousand, and the French also lost men and had one cruiser damaged. In Taiwan, between October 1884 and March 1885, the French sent two expeditionary columns totalling four or five thousand men, Liu Mingchuan's troops held Tamsui and Keelung behind their works, and the French were beaten back in the action at Sanchiaochun. Range and consumption can also be compared: the maximum range of the French eighty millimetre rifled gun was around five thousand metres against the thousand-odd metres of the old Chinese village guns, so the same shell travelled more than three times as far, and it was correspondingly harder to bring supporting fire up to the guns. In money, the French war cost ran to hundreds of millions of francs on the usual reckoning; the Chinese expenditure was spread across the supply and transport accounts of Guangxi and Yunnan and reached some tens of millions of taels of silver, of which a considerable share was wasted on transport that could not be organised.
cause: 這場戰爭是殖民政略與邊防尊嚴撞埋一齊的結果。法國自一八七〇年代就覬覦安南，一八七三年紙橋之役失利後一度退走，之後重新集結兵力，一八八〇年攻入河內，一八八二年控制北寧與山西，穩住紅河三角洲，再要求安南王朝交出土地、礦權與關稅自主，並企圖沿紅河開一條通雲南的商路。清廷起初把法國的進取當作地方糾紛，一八八三年五月法軍攻陷河內王城、安南王阮寶山向清廷求援，朝廷才決定出兵，先以岑毓英的滇軍剿辦劉永福黑旗軍，再將黑旗軍收編、並派張之洞主持廣西軍務，戰爭性質由剿匪變成中法兩國的正面交戰。直接導火線是法軍不斷越過中越邊境追擊黑旗軍、清廷要求法軍退出中國境內而法國拒絕，同時法方在談判中把衝突責任推給清廷，聲稱只有出兵才能迫使廣西與雲南當局放棄干預。法國內部則有政治壓力：茹費理政府面對共和派反對與殖民事業的開支，需要一場勝仗來維持聲望，於是加快增兵，把一場邊境衝突推向全面戰爭。清朝主和與主戰兩派意見相左：李鴻章衡量全局認為不宜為越南與法國開戰，張之洞與在閩的左宗棠則認為一旦退讓，法國必步步進逼，雲南廣西永無寧日。遠方亦有旁觀者：英國不願見法國勢力直抵雲南門戶卻不肯出兵，美國保持中立，德國廠商則在中國與法國兩邊同時出售火炮與步槍，賺的是戰爭的錢。
causeEn: This war was the outcome of colonial ambition colliding with the Chinese sense of frontier dignity. From the 1870s France had coveted Annam; after the reverse at Paper Bridge in 1873 it withdrew for a time, then gathered its forces again, entered Hanoi in 1880, controlled Bac Ninh and Son Tay in 1882, stabilised its hold on the Red River delta, and then demanded that the Annamite court surrender land, mining rights and tariff autonomy, while trying to open a trade road up the Red River towards Yunnan. The Qing court at first treated French pressure as a local disturbance. Only when the French took the citadel of Hanoi in May 1883 and the Annamite king Nguyễn Phúc Đồng Khánh appealed to Beijing did the court decide to intervene, first sending the Yunnan army of Cen Yuying against Liu Yongfu's Black Flags, then taking the Black Flags into imperial service and appointing Zhang Zhidong to direct military affairs in Guangxi; what had begun as a campaign against a rebel band turned into a direct war between two states. The immediate spark was that French troops kept crossing the Sino-Vietnamese frontier in pursuit of the Black Flags, that the Qing court demanded the French withdraw from Chinese territory and the French refused, and that at the negotiating table Paris placed the blame for the clashes on the Chinese and announced that only military pressure would force the authorities in Guangxi and Yunnan to stop interfering. There was political pressure in France as well: the Ferry government, challenged at home by the republicans and weighed down by the cost of the colonial undertaking, needed a victory to sustain its prestige, so it reinforced the army and turned a border incident into a general war. Inside the Qing the advocates of peace and of war disagreed: Li Hongzhang, weighing the whole situation, held that it was unwise to go to war with France over Vietnam, while Zhang Zhidong and Zuo Zongtang, then in Fujian, argued that any concession would let France advance step by step and leave Yunnan and Guangxi permanently unsettled. There were distant onlookers too. Britain did not want French power reaching the gateway of Yunnan but would not fight for it, the United States stayed neutral, and German firms sold guns and rifles to both China and France and profited from the war.
impact: 這場戰爭對兩個國家都留下長的痕跡。對法國而言，越南到手是最大的收成：一八八四年法軍佔領河內與安南，一八八五年攻下諒山與鎮南關，一八八七年法國把交趾支那、柬埔寨與安南合併成法屬印度支那聯邦，紅河航線從此通到雲南，一九一〇年滇越鐵路通車時，法國的影響力已沿鐵軌直抵昆明邊緣。對清朝而言，越南是丟了，但條約並沒有割地賠款，法國反而承認雲南與廣西的主權，這在甲午之前算是不幸中的萬幸；代價是對外威信的重挫，輿論把輸掉越南算成李鴻章外交的敗筆，湖南士人更以此攻擊曾國荃、李鴻章一系。軍事的教訓更為具體：法軍以線膛砲配速射砲、加上電報與嚴密的後勤體系，在關隘前的火力壓制遠勝清軍；清廷在戰後加速整軍，設天津武備學堂，練湖北新軍，江南製造局仿製德造後膛砲，一八八五年台灣建省，劉銘傳在島上設防務、辦煤礦、修電報與鐵路，一八八七到一八九一年間的這些工程，成為十年後台灣抗拒割臺的物質底子。清朝在西北同時平定阿古柏之亂並設新疆省，東南則受挫於越南，一個在內政上被迫加速改革。國際層面上，這場戰爭讓德國軍火商打開了中國市場，中國的軍火採購自此大量落在克虜伯等德國廠商手上，也讓法國在亞洲感到被孤立，法俄接近與法國的遠東擴張在同一時期並行。國內政治上，裁撤湘淮軍帶來的失業與不滿，成為一八八五年廣州起義部分人群的心理背景，士人對政府的不信任在往後十年間不斷累積。
impactEn: The war left long traces in both countries. For France the prize was Annam: the French occupied Hanoi and Annam in 1884, took Lang Son and Zhennan Pass in 1885, and in 1887 combined Cochinchina, Cambodia and Annam into the French Indochina union, with the Red River route running through to Yunnan, and by the time the Yunnan railway opened in 1910 French influence had reached along the rails to the edge of Kunming. For the Qing, Vietnam was lost, but the treaty ceded no territory and demanded no indemnity; on the contrary France recognised Chinese sovereignty over Yunnan and Guangxi, which in the years before the Sino-Japanese War counted as the best of a bad outcome. The price was a heavy blow to outward prestige: public opinion treated the loss of Vietnam as a diplomatic defeat for Li Hongzhang, and scholars in Hunan used it to attack the Zeng and Li factions. The military lesson was more concrete. With rifled guns backed by quick-firing pieces, and with the telegraph and a tight supply system, the French could put far more fire on the passes than the Chinese could, and the Qing court afterwards hurried to reform its armies: it set up the Tianjin Military Academy, trained the new Hubei army, had the Jiangnan Arsenal copy German breech-loading guns, and in 1885 created the province of Taiwan, where Liu Mingchuan set up coastal defence, opened coal mines, and built telegraph lines and railways. Those works, carried out between 1887 and 1891, became the material foundation of the resistance to the cession of Taiwan a decade later. While the Qing were suppressing the revolt of Agub in the north-west and establishing Xinjiang as a province, they were being checked in the south-east by Vietnam, and the combination forced reform at home. On the international plane, the war opened the Chinese market to German arms merchants, since Chinese purchasing of ordnance now fell largely to firms such as Krupp, and it left France feeling isolated in Asia, with the French rapprochement with Russia running alongside the expansion in the Far East. In domestic politics, the unemployment and resentment that followed the disbandment of the Hunan and Huai armies formed part of the background to the Guangzhou rising of 1885, and the distrust of the government among the scholar class kept accumulating for the next decade.
result: 戰爭以中法天津條約收場。一八八五年六月九日，代表清朝的李鴻章與代表法國的茹費理在北京簽訂條約，內容大致是：法國承認雲南與廣西為中國領土，中國承認法國對越南的宗主權，兩國軍隊各自撤出對方境內，邊界由後來勘界另行議定。戰場上的收束則更冷清：一八八五年三月，法軍重新奪回一八八四年清軍血戰奪得的鎮南關，五月進取諒山，清軍節節退入廣西境內；雲南方面滇軍自宜光、興化等地全數撤回，岑毓英遭參劾；臺灣方面法軍在淡水與基隆受阻後撤走，劉銘傳守住了島北，雙方未再大規模交鋒。對法國來說，軍事目標達成，代價卻極重：戰費以億計，遠征軍的傷病數字遠超戰鬥損失，茹費理內閣在一八八五年垮台，法國在亞洲的孤立感反而加深，條約裡幾乎沒有為法國爭到通商特權，商人期望的雲南市場並未打開。對清朝而言，條約保住了雲南與廣西的邊疆名義，但邊界仍未勘定，廣西與雲南自此長期處於前線狀態；中法之間在安南的角力延續到一八八七年的勘界再起爭端，直到一八八九年前後界線才大致落實，此後中法在邊境的零星衝突仍持續數十年，直到二十世紀四十年代法屬印度支那的崩解才真正終止。結果是雙方都沒有得到想要的東西：法國得到了越南卻失去遠東商路的想像，清朝保住了領土卻把邊防的負擔留給了後人，越南本身則以被保護國的名義，捲入下一段殖民主義的歷史。
resultEn: The war ended with the Sino-French Treaty of Tientsin. On the ninth of June 1885 Li Hongzhang, representing the Qing court, and Jules Ferry, representing France, signed the convention at Peking. Its substance was that France recognised Yunnan and Guangxi as Chinese territory, China recognised French suzerainty over Vietnam, the armies of each withdrew from the other's territory, and the frontier itself was left to a later demarcation commission. The military conclusion was colder still. In March 1885 the French retook Zhennan Pass, which the Chinese had won by hard fighting in 1884, and in May they advanced on Lang Son while the Chinese forces fell back by stages into Guangxi; in Yunnan the troops withdrew in full from places such as Huong Giang and Huong Hoa, and Cen Yuying was impeached. In Taiwan the French, checked at Tamsui and Keelung, withdrew, and Liu Mingchuan held the north of the island, with no further large-scale engagement between the two. For France the military objective was achieved at an enormous price: the cost ran to hundreds of millions of francs, the sickness and wounds of the expeditionary armies far exceeded the battle losses, the Ferry government fell in 1885, and French isolation in Asia deepened rather than eased. The treaty secured almost no commercial privilege for France, and the Yunnan market that merchants had expected never opened. For the Qing, the treaty preserved the formal integrity of the Yunnan and Guangxi frontier, but the line was still undrawn and both provinces remained permanently on the front; the rivalry between China and France in Annam ran on into the demarcation disputes of 1887, and the boundary was only roughly fixed around 1889, after which sporadic clashes on the frontier continued for decades, ending only with the collapse of French Indochina in the 1940s. In the end neither side obtained what it wanted: France gained Vietnam but lost the vision of a road into the Far East, the Qing saved its territory but handed the burden of the frontier to its successors, and Vietnam itself entered the next chapter of colonial history as a protectorate.
